name: No callback verification on payment instructions
description: Verbal or email instructions actioned without out-of-band callback to a known number.

name: Payment changes accepted by email only
description: Bank-detail changes accepted from email without independent verification.

name: No supplier-onboarding verification
description: New suppliers added without identity / bank-account verification.

name: No dual control on payments above threshold
description: Single individual can initiate and approve payments above material threshold.

name: No 3DS / strong customer auth on card flows
description: SCA absent or routinely waived, increasing card fraud rates.

name: No velocity / behavioural rules on transactions
description: Static thresholds only; no behavioural or device-context rules.

name: No Confirmation of Payee on outbound
description: Beneficiary name not validated against account number.

name: No customer warning at risky payment moments
description: No targeted warning when payment shape matches APP-fraud patterns.

name: No fraud signal at account onboarding
description: No device fingerprinting / velocity / identity-data checks at account opening.

name: No money-mule detection rules
description: No rapid-in / rapid-out / structured-deposit / unusual-counterparty rules.

name: No segregation of duties for cash / records
description: Same individual handles cash, records and reconciliation.

name: No monitoring of privileged staff actions
description: Admin actions not logged; no review of credit overrides / refund issuance.
